name: Stamp Duty Land Tax: residential property rates
appliesTo: Residential property in England and Northern Ireland, for a buyer who will own one home after the purchase. Scotland and Wales have different taxes.

firstTimeBuyerRelief.aboveMaxPrice: Above £500,000 the relief cannot be claimed and the standard rates apply to the whole price.
